1iv1:
Program Description

This Middlesex University course gives students the tools to succeed in this dynamic and rewarding profession.

Accountancy is at the core of every business which means that the BA Accounting and Finance course offers students a range of opportunities in every industry, from banking to fashion and everywhere in between. Students will develop their advanced theoretical knowledge as well as a practical understanding of all things finance. Covering key areas within financial and management accounting, taxation and business law, they’ll gain a deep understanding of the role accounting plays in successful organisations.

During their studies, students will have the opportunity to do a paid work placement, either as a year-long project or two shorter placements. Here students will get the chance to test and improve their technical skills in the real world, as well as building their soft employability skills such as communication and team work.
1iv4:
Program Description

This versatile business management BA degree gives students the space to develop their management skills. Whatever their goals are, students can build their business expertise before beginning a fulfilling career.

During the course, students will build the professional skill set needed to deal with the challenges they'll face in the fast-paced corporate world, from financial skills enabling them to make monetary decisions to supply management skills allowing them to keep a business operating. Developing their theory in the lecture halls, students will study the operations of organizations, strategy, design & production, resource acquisition, business processes and more.

Once they’ve built up that foundation of knowledge, students will have the opportunity to undertake a paid work placement, where students will put the theory they’ve learned into practice, developing their working knowledge of business and figuring out what they would like to specialise in.
1iv8:
Understanding contemporary corporate finance is the key to understanding modern business. Covering all areas of finance including investment analysis and capital management, students will have the tools to solve financial problems faced by business today.

This course is tailored towards ambitious students who want a management and finance degree, and they will learn in a live environment. Using data from the London Stock Exchange, students will form portfolios of listed companies and compare it against the market. They’ll identify over and under-priced companies, as well as calculating Beta, among other skills.

Students will take on the challenge of a work placement, developing their theory and practical skills to an employable level, as well as developing their understanding of financial organisations.

During this BA in Business Management (Finance), students will develop key business skills to help them in a management or financial career. Focusing on topics such as resource management, leadership, business finance and analysis, students will have the ability to work effectively as part of a team. Presenting and communicating their ideas will give them confidence in a fast paced business environment, and they'll have specialist knowledge in business strategy and process.

Through this course students can become a student member of the Chartered Management Institute, leading to full membership upon graduation. They’ll also successfully train to get Bloomberg and DataStream certificates during their degree, a key part of the course.
1iw4:
International business degrees are in high demand in the global world. With this Middlesex University course, students will develop a range of transferable skills which are essential in business settings. These include communication, information technology, critical thinking, and teamwork.

Students will gain these skills alongside a deep theoretical foundation that’ll cover marketing, human resource management, global strategy, intercultural ethics, and many more. Expert tutors, with years of international business experience will prepare students for an exciting career in the global marketplace.

During their studies, students will have an opportunity to do a year of study abroad, linked with partner universities in Europe and the USA. This will deepen their understanding of what international business is and help them to apply their skills and knowledge in an international setting.

Middlesex University's modules are specifically designed to give all the tools students will need to succeed in an international business career. Many of the modules are work placement based to help integrate their knowledge with work from the very start, without having to extend their studies by a year. During these modules, students will create and develop a personal development portfolio which will include their CV and covering letter, applications, and records of how students secured their work experience. They’ll get a chance to review their skills critically, identifying areas of success and improvement.
1iwu:
Program Description

Middlesex University is internationally known for their law expertise – and the LLB Law puts students at the heart of legal innovation. This law course gives students the initial skills and qualifications to succeed in the legal profession and pursue qualified solicitor or barrister status in England and Wales. Recognized by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board, this course gives students the intellectual knowledge and transferable skills to innovate, reform and thrive in the legal profession.

Students will explore the wide range of legal concepts, values, principles and rules as they gain an expert knowledge of the core principles of the law in England and Wales. They’ll also put theory into practice with work-based modules that will develop their professional skills. This Middlesex University course ensures students practice their skills as they study. Middlesex places students with professional legal bodies and practitioners, giving them the opportunity to get work experience alongside their theoretical studies.
1iz1:
Program Description

Middlesex University's LLB Law with Criminology lets students study two complementary perspectives while they gain the initial academic skills to become a qualified solicitor or barrister in England and Wales. They are internationally known for both their law and criminology expertise – and this law with criminology course puts students at the heart of legal innovation. Recognised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board, this Middlesex course gives students the intellectual knowledge and transferable skills that make up the first stage of professional legal education.

Students will learn the core principles of law in England and Wales while they develop their understanding of criminology – and the complexities this presents. Students will also put theory into practice with work-based modules that will help them develop the hands-on skills and expertise to compete in both the criminal justice system and the legal profession.

With this course, students will practice their skills as they study. Work placements are integral to the programme – Middlesex places their students with professional legal bodies, so they get work experience alongside their theoretical studies.
1iz3:
Program Description

During this course students will learn about the challenges and opportunities within international relations while gaining the initial qualifications to pursue qualified solicitor or barrister status in England and Wales. Middlesex University has an international reputation for their law expertise – and the law with international relations course gives students the skills and support to thrive. Recognised by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board as the first stage of professional training, this course equips students with the intellectual knowledge and experience that make up the first stage of professional legal training.

Students will learn the core principles of law in England and Wales while they develop their knowledge of international relations. They'll also put theory into practice with work-based modules that will help students develop the hands-on skills and expertise to succeed in the legal profession – both in the UK and internationally.

Work placements play a vital role in this course. Middlesex has an excellent network of relationships with high-profile international organizations and they'll get the opportunity to gain work experience with them as part of the course.
8csj:
Why Study Artificial Intelligence and Data Science BSc Honours at Middlesex?

The Artificial Intelligence and Data Science BSc Honours at Middlesex University provides students with real-world skills and practical experience from day one. Students learn how AI and Data Science systems function, master the latest AI technologies from leading experts, and develop the skills and experience required for immediate entry into the job market or further academic study. With global demand for professionals in this field on the rise, the course equips graduates with everything needed to succeed in this exciting, high-demand sector.

Develop Critical Skills in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

Students gain a solid understanding of AI principles, implementation techniques, and approaches to solving Data Science problems using Python and other programming languages. The curriculum includes a wide range of machine learning algorithms such as neural networks, support vector machines, genetic algorithms, and generative AI. Learners also engage with cutting-edge technologies, including large language models, ontology management systems, and distributed processing tools, applying them to real-world problems in computer vision and Natural Language Processing (NLP).

Collaborate with Experts and Use Cutting-Edge Facilities

Courses are taught by experts working at the forefront of AI and data science. Students have opportunities to lead teams, collaborate on innovative, real-world projects, and develop crucial computational, entrepreneurial, and communication skills for their future careers. Learning takes place in state-of-the-art laboratories equipped with the latest industry-standard technologies.

Apply Learning in the Workplace and Prepare for a Dynamic Career

The programme includes the option for a work placement, allowing students to apply their learning in professional environments, gain valuable industry experience, and build a strong professional network before graduation. Upon completion of the course, graduates are prepared for careers in AI development, research, machine learning, and data analysis across a wide range of industries, including technology, healthcare, and finance.

Middlesex University’s employability service, MDXworks, supports students in finding placements and career opportunities, helping them strengthen their applications and providing the tools needed for career success.

Graduates leave the programme with a deep understanding of AI and data science theory, as well as practical experience that prepares them for employment or further study. The course provides a strong foundation and comprehensive support, ensuring graduates enter this high-growth, transformative sector with a competitive edge.
1j1y:
All industries now utilise data and Applied AI and Data Science and Data-Analytics are increasingly identified as key industrial activities. The position of Data Scientist is rapidly becoming a required post for any company that wishes to take full advantage of the data that they collect. This course is designed to give students the skills to step into a career as a Data Scientist in a wide range of industries and companies.

This masters has been designed to offer those with a familiarity in maths, science or computing an opportunity to develop a key set of skills for future employment in a way that builds on students' existing knowledge and skill base. Upon completing the course, students will be ready to fulfil the requirements of a Data Scientist.

Students will focus on the intertwining areas of machine learning, visual analytics and data governance, and be able to strike a balance between theoretical underpinnings, practical hands-on experience, and acquisition of industrially-relevant languages and packages. Students will also be exposed to cutting-edge contemporary research activity within data science that will equip them with the potential to pursue a research-based career, and, in particular, further PhD study at Middlesex University.
1j20:
This Master of Science - Data Science with Integrated Placement course has been designed to offer those with a familiarity in mathematical science or computing an opportunity to develop a set of skills for future employment in a way that builds on their existing knowledge and skills. After finishing the course, they will be ready to enter a career as a data scientist.

They will focus on the interconnected areas of machine learning, visual analytics, and data governance, and learn to strike a balance between theory, practice, and the acquisition of industrially relevant languages and packages.

They will also be exposed to cutting-edge contemporary research activity within data science that will equip them with the potential to pursue a research-based career, and, in particular, further PhD study at Middlesex.
1j22:
Digital will continue to change the face of marketing for many years to come. Those who succeed will need knowledge of the consumer and how today digital marketing and analytics is at the heart of marketing. Aspiring marketers need to understand the digital consumer and how the tools of digital work in practice; as well as the latest frameworks to plan, implement and evaluate digital marketing activity.

With a Masters in Digital Marketing, students will prepare themselves to meet the needs of organisations across a variety of sectors by developing skills in crucial areas such as e-marketing, consumer psychology, and more.

This course will prepare students for a successful career with a comprehensive take on digital marketing and a strong emphasis on the application of theory to practice, in subject areas such as e-marketing, social media, analytics, consumer psychology and digital advertising. It has been designed for graduates who have studies in fields such as marketing, media, management and social sciences, as well as professionals working in marketing across public, private and voluntary sectors seeking specialist knowledge and career development.

Embedding an understanding of digital marketing strategies, dynamics and platforms, students will take the knowledge and skills developed in the course and apply them to a variety of practice based, real-life learning will complement theory.
1j29:
Program Description

Environmental health is the branch of public health concerned with how people's living, working and leisure environments affect their health. It's a gripping subject to study and a fascinating field to work in. Whether students are helping improve the living conditions of society's poorest, or working with a company to improve health and safety for staff and customers, their work will have a huge, life-changing and often life-saving impact.

This course is highly work-focused, with a strong emphasis on practical laboratory work and real-life case studies and students will be able to take advantage of Middlesex University's close links within the industry.

The course is centred on UK law and practice, but is designed to be flexible and provide education and training that will be valuable internationally. Students will have access to a range of excellent facilities including a microbiology laboratory and pestology materials. They will be able to study specialist modules areas such as food safety, and health and safety which are particularly valued by both local authorities and the private sector.

Many of the teaching staff are chartered environmental health practitioners and under their expert guidance, previous students have done research into a wide variety of areas, including listeria in food, the effects of heavy smoking, skin lightening, water pollution and the attitudes of people living in high-rise buildings towards recycling.
1j2d:
Program Description

An effective supply chain goes beyond the successful input and output of goods and services. With the right management, a supply chain has the power to influence entire business processes, create value and unite multiple organisations from all over the world. This complex discipline, with elements of IT, logistics and procurement, is increasingly important in today's globalised environment of interconnected networks.

In recent decades, organisations have become increasingly reliant on effective supply chains in order to compete in the global market. This Middlesex University course equips students with a global view of the strategic and operational processes they need to manage the key functions of these supply chain processes, including transportation, warehousing, inventory management and production planning. Middlesex University combines advanced theory teaching with practical skills training in well-known software such as SAP®and Arena® to give students a core understanding of the contemporary issues and programs used in global supply chain management.

With easy access to the corporate world from the London campus, students will develop methods of strategic and critical thinking to enhance their ability to effectively manage and improve existing structures within domestic and international companies. This real-world focus to the course ensures that students are able to respond to a variety of challenges with confidence and ingenuity, enhancing their ability to lead and helping them to advance into more senior roles quickly and capably.
1j3h:
An MBA is still as relevant as ever for those business professionals who are serious about advancing their career. Middlesex University's approach will help develop students' understanding in a range of management disciplines as well as equip them with the leadership skills to progress their career.

Middlesex University's MBA is designed to prepare students for the challenges of management, exposing them to the latest thinking in business across a variety of sectors within an international context. Students will engage with key management disciplines including financial and economic analysis, strategy and innovation, managing and developing people, global marketing management, operations and supply chain management, and cross-cultural management and ethics.

Fundamental to Middlesex University's approach is a focus on both theory and practice. Students will engage in activities from lectures, workshops, talks from visiting speakers alongside the opportunity to work on a field-based consulting project. students' final project will allow them to further develop their consulting skills, write a business plan or engage in a more traditional academic report.
7mys:
This Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Executive course aims to develop business leaders capable of managing and innovating across a range of organizations in an increasingly global, diverse, and dynamic market environment. The university's modules are designed to broaden student's perspectives across leadership, marketing, finance, operations, strategy, and ethics.

By completing the Middlesex University Executive MBA, students will develop and emerge as well-rounded, strategic leaders with the tools needed to navigate the complexities of today’s global business environment.
